summary:
I'm a Full Stack Developer with **.NET Core** as my main focus. On the frontend, I build scalable, high-performance interfaces with **React** and **Next.js**, and turn to lightweight **Node.js** solutions such as **Express.js** when the project calls for it.

I've worked on development, integration, and deployment across **SaaS**, **IoT**, and cloud projects; I use **AWS** services actively in my day-to-day work.

education.degree: B.S. Management Information Systems (Open Education — compatible with full-time work)

projects.title: Tilegen
projects.description: AI-powered visualization platform for ceramic and surface manufacturers/sellers. Integrated third-party AI APIs end to end, modernized the database onto a relational cloud store, and shipped backend services on AWS Lightsail with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.title: Voonnect
projects.description: A training-management platform that turns English speaking practice into a daily routine. It matches a student with a teacher, auto-creates 10-minute sessions for Monday–Friday, delivers prep material before each one, and runs the sessions on Telegram with a reminder bot. I worked end to end on the landing site, matching and scheduling logic, and the Telegram bot integration.

projects.title: greenbar
projects.description: Browser-based tool that turns a GitHub avatar into an ASCII portrait and a profile README you can paste straight into your repo. Everything runs in the tab; no backend or account needed.

projects.title: SiteHarvest
projects.description: Local-first terminal app that learns a browser flow once, then replays it to collect repeating page items like text, images and URLs. Runs on your own machine; results land on disk as JSON and media files.

projects.title: dotnet-next-boilerplate
projects.description: Boilerplate starter for full-stack apps with .NET and Next.js — a ready foundation for modern web projects.

projects.title: react-vite-ts-boilerplate
projects.description: React + Vite + TypeScript starter template with a clean project structure for building modern SPAs quickly.
